content: Expose observation/action frames and units, compute coordinate transformations numerically, and describe native replanning before transferring a correction between initial conditions. A transformed initial displacement is not itself a measured downstream error.
applicability: Original Piper MuJoCo socket3; native plug-relative transport replanning; tested holder world-X shifts +/-1.5mm; requested gpt-6-astra
embodiment: Current dual Piper original simulation profile; privileged geometry; no real extrinsic claim
known_limits: N=2 initial states; not a new task family
Candidate has additional frame/primitive information; not a pure reasoning comparison
Observation API requires accurate simulator state; not real RGB pose estimation
